people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”
translations.bsb: But Saul sent the messengers back to see David and told them, “Bring him up to me in his bed so I can kill him.”
translations.kjv: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
translations.asv: And Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
